necromancer.label: Ambrose
necromancer.description: Raise a defeated opponent as a zombie or call a skeleton onto an open neighboring tile. Both pursue opponents on their own. A skeleton's Wave can also hurt nearby allies.

necro_stay_friend.label: Stay, Friend
necro_stay_friend.help: Summon a skeleton on an open neighboring tile. It greets normally but does not pursue.

raise_dead.label: Raise Dead
raise_dead.help: Choose an unoccupied enemy corpse. It becomes a zombie with half the enemy's maximum HP, rounded up.

summon_skeleton.label: Summon Skeleton
summon_skeleton.help: Choose an open neighboring tile for a 1 HP skeleton. It first acts next round.
